name: 简体中文
register: Neutral and concise, as mainland Chinese software uses; avoid 您/你 unless the sentence needs direct address (then 你). Buttons as short verbs ("保存", "重启"). Full-width punctuation ，。：（）“”.
notes: Chinese has one plural form. No spaces between Chinese characters; a space between Chinese and Latin text or numbers is optional - keep it consistent (no space). Keep product names in Latin script.
